operator_observation.stage: Decode draft model initialization, before decode HTTP readiness
operator_observation.observation: Decode TP0 was waiting in the TP worker seed broadcast. Decode TP2, TP5, TP8, TP10 and TP13 were waiting in the logits gatherer topology broadcast. Prefill was HTTP-ready. Neither decode node updated its log for more than three minutes.
operator_observation.action: Time-boxed the readiness waiter. The fresh one-step control uses the DP LM head to avoid the distributed logits-gatherer topology probe and one speculative step to bypass the idle multi-step loop.
